title: ASC 250 Error Correction Analysis
description: Extension schema for the vwp-accounting-asc250 extension. Constrains a core calculation object of type 'errorCorrectionAnalysis': per misstated account, the as-reported amount and the correction by period, the restated amounts and the cumulative correction, and the SAB 108 dual-method quantification (rollover: the largest single-period misstatement; iron curtain: the cumulative uncorrected misstatement) against a materiality basis that cites its fact. Located by type under calculations/.

correctionDate.description: The date the cumulative correction is recorded as of (the opening of the earliest period presented for a restatement, or the current period date for an out-of-period correction).

lineItem.description: The financial statement line item misstated.

accountRole.description: Semantic role of the balance sheet account whose balance is wrong at correctionDate.

offsetRole.description: Semantic role the correction offsets to: prior_period_adjustment (opening retained earnings) for a restatement, or the income statement role for an out-of-period correction in the current period.

balanceSide.description: The natural balance of accountRole; a positive correction increases that balance.

asReported.description: The account's balance at this period end as previously reported.

correction.description: Signed increase to the account's natural balance arising in this period; its magnitude is the period's income statement misstatement. Periods are listed chronologically and the balance carries earlier corrections forward.

quantitativeThreshold.description: Decimal share of the basis above which a misstatement is quantitatively material (0.05 = 5%).

basis.description: The benchmark (pretax income, revenue, total assets).

basisFact.description: Fact id whose numeric value equals basisAmount.

materialityJudgmentRef.description: The judgment id that weighs the quantitative result with the SAB 99 qualitative factors.

asRestated.description: asReported + the cumulative correction through this period.

maxPeriodCorrection.description: The largest absolute single-period misstatement across all lines.

cumulativeCorrection.description: The absolute cumulative uncorrected misstatement at correctionDate across all lines.
